summary: 18 bugs ranked by severity x blast-radius from 31 confirmed findings (2 refuted excluded). Theme: platform-model-name leaks + reservation bypasses + cross-tenant isolation + telemetry duplication.

bugs.title: R7 label drift Guard Model / ZeroShield Guard instead of ZeroShield Model

bugs.title: R9 telemetry drainers share PROCESSING_KEY -> 2x-4x EnforcementEvent duplication
bugs.suggested_fix: Single drainer (beat) now; per-invocation key + Redis lock + DB unique (org_id,request_id)

bugs.title: R10 RAG case-variant collection name evades deny+block_sensitive -> PII persists
bugs.suggested_fix: Lowercase before get_policy + namespace; fail closed for non-default no-policy collections

bugs.title: R11 per-tenant admins are superusers; ?organization_id reads + compile-pushes other orgs
R12 terminated user keeps minting JWT via token/refresh (refresh path unchecked)
bugs.suggested_fix: AtomicTokenRefreshSerializer.validate add TerminatedSession check before super().validate()

bugs.title: R13 ReDoS guard misses alternation-overlap + quantified-wildcard-group (9.7s)
R14 non-dict JSON body 500s across 4 control endpoints
bugs.suggested_fix: body=request.data if dict else {}; max_length ModelIsolate; reject non-dict poc; map errors to 400

bugs.title: R15 access token survives password change for full 60-min TTL
bugs.suggested_fix: Add password_changed_at, reject older-iat tokens; or shorten ACCESS_TOKEN_LIFETIME

bugs.title: R16 context scan misses canonical 'ignore all previous instructions'
bugs.suggested_fix: Rewrite INDIRECT_INJECTION_PATTERNS[0] to allow optional all/previous between trigger/target

bugs.title: R17 raw PII in pipeline_trace prompt fields; trailing-dot collection leaks namespace
R18 gateway MCP events miss write_risk; stale kill-switch keeps model 503 in HALF_OPEN
bugs.suggested_fix: _record_event compute write_risk; circuit_breaker clear kill-switch after _begin_half_open

fix_plan:
A PLATFORM-MODEL CONTAINMENT (backend, first; shared roots): A1 platform_models bedrock/-prefix fix (R3, closes R4+enable_routing) first; A2 llm_router/compiler provider=internal filters (R2) with A1; A3 scanner+pipeline_trace scrub+GUARD_MODEL_LABEL (R1,R7) parallel; A4 error-sanitizer (R5)+embeddings validation (R6, after A2); A5 routing-audit echo+control normalizer+ModelState rename+/v1/models dedup (R4-control,R8). Lanes: gateway A1-A4, control A2-compiler/A5/R8.
B ISOLATION+AUTH (parallel): B1 platform-operator flag+compile guard+test (R11); B2 refresh-path termination (R12)+password_changed_at (R15).
C DATA-PLANE (parallel): C1 drainer race (R9) config-then-code; C2 RAG case-fold/fail-closed (R10)+context-scan (R16)+pipeline_trace PII+collection validation (R17).
D INPUT-BOUNDARY (parallel): D1 non-dict 500s (R14); D2 ReDoS (R13); D3 MCP write-risk+circuit-breaker (R18).
E FRONTEND (after backend constants): E1 label-drift (R7,R8) after A3/A5; R1 strip independent.
Parallel: A-gateway, A-control, B, C1, C2, D concurrent. Hard order: A1+A2 before verify; A2-compiler before A4/R6; A3/A5 before E1. Day-one: telemetry beat flag + A1 one-liner.
